items.label: Procurement Strategy
items.detail: Shop high-performance alpine gear at Decathlon in Chennai, India, to save costs compared to Sri Lanka, then supplement missing items in Kathmandu's Thamel district.

items.label: Layering System
items.detail: Pack 4–6 sets of thermal base layers, lightweight micro-fleece mid-layers, and a heavy down jacket rated for -10°C to -15°C with a waterproof shell.

items.label: Footwear & Bottoms
items.detail: Use high-altitude, ankle-support waterproof boots rated for sub-zero temperatures, paired with fleece-lined winter trekking trousers and waterproof rain pants.

items.label: Backpack & Camp Gear
items.detail: Carry a 50L–70L ergonomic backpack with hip support, rain covers, trekking poles, heavy-duty luggage padlocks, and a 4-season sub-zero sleeping bag.

items.label: Weight Management
items.detail: Reduce excess body fat (the vlogger dropped from 84 kg to ~72 kg) to ease knee and joint strain during steep climbs.

items.label: Cardio Base
items.detail: Walk or run 10 km to 15 km daily for 1–2 months leading up to the trek.

items.label: Strength & Core
items.detail: Perform calisthenics (pull-ups, dips, and core workouts) to build endurance for carrying daypacks on prolonged ascents.

items.label: International Route
items.detail: Fly Colombo (CMB) to Kathmandu (KTM) via transit hubs like Chennai (MAA), keeping a 2–4 hour buffer for Indian airport security.

items.label: Lukla Domestic Flights
items.detail: Fly from Kathmandu or Ramechhap Airport to Lukla (Tenzing-Hillary Airport) via regional carriers (Summit Air, Tara Air, Sita Air).

items.label: Strict Luggage Limits
items.detail: Keep total luggage under 15 kg (maximum 10 kg checked duffle + 5 kg carry-on daypack).

items.label: Weather & Helicopter Backups
items.detail: Flights are frequently canceled due to mountain weather; maintain an emergency cash/card buffer for charter helicopter transfers.

items.label: Standard 12-Day EBC Trek Package
items.detail: ~$1,390 – $1,500 USD (covers guide, porter, permits, teahouses, and meals).

items.label: Kathmandu ⇄ Lukla Flights
items.detail: ~$300 – $400 USD return.

items.label: Daily On-Trail Out-of-Pocket Expenses
items.detail: ~$15 – $30 USD/day for hot showers, Wi-Fi access, device charging, and boiled drinking water.

items.label: Local Nepal SIM Card
items.detail: ~$20 – $36 USD at Tribhuvan International Airport for data connectivity.

items.label: Certified Guides
items.detail: Always hire licensed Sherpa guides for navigation, lodge bookings, and altitude monitoring.

items.label: Buffer Days
items.detail: Add 3–5 contingency days at the end of the trip to absorb flight cancellations at Lukla without missing international flights.

items.label: Gradual Acclimatization
items.detail: Strictly follow acclimatization rest days in Namche Bazaar and Dingboche rather than rushing the ascent.
